description:
Executor the desktop workflow application for Windows. Speed up your daily workflow, opening things and doing things.

Executor the desktop workflow application for Windows. Speed up your daily workflow, opening things and doing things.

Key Features:
- Launch applications, files, folders, websites, web services (with parameters) and prompts in milliseconds.
- Trigger multiple actions with one text command and/or hotkey.
- Let's be an expert in opening up the world instead of trying to put the whole world inside of Executor (as some alternatives try to do).
- Take the clipboard to a new level, swiftly trigger system commands, do fast calculations, manage running applications and more.
- Tailor keywords, appearance, hotkeys, and behavior to perfectly match your daily workflow.
- Customize the look and feel with various skins and theming options to match your desktop setup.
What's new
- The list now supports Pinned items. These will be listed first when the input is empty. Press Ctrl+P to pin/unpin an item, press Ctrl+Up/Down to move a pinned item, press Shift+Ctrl+Up/Down to move a pinned item to the top or bottom of pinned items. You can also right-click items for pinning options.
  - Added a setting to hide the "Pinned" header in the list. Setting name is pinnedheader more info here.
  - Added a setting that enables pressing the delete key on a pinned item to remove it fast (instead of Ctrl+P or right-click menu). Setting name is pinneddelete more info here.
  - Added a new keyword showpinned this can show/hide all pinned items in the list. The keyword can be imported from extras.exc (type imports). This uses the new $SHOWPINNED$ keyword command. Keyword syntax: [on,off,?,(empty=toggle)].
  - In Incognito mode config you can add "7" to only show pinned item in list, or you can add "p" to not show pinned items when in Incognito mode.

- In Incognito mode config you can add "8" to not show items in input when in Incognito mode (where other modes are mostly focused on the list).
- Added input command -c (and -check) to check for a new version of Executor.
Fixes
- Fixed pressing F9 on input suggestion items would in many cases not bring up the proper context menu.
